title: اختر عالم لوحة المطعم — Choose the restaurant console's world
question: The roll assigned The Sufra (the mezze table seen from above). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Sufra — السُّفرة
options.lineage: Levantine mezze spread: many small plates around one table, seen from above
options.thesis: The restaurant's back office set like its own table: za'atar, sumac, olive oil and tahini doing the jobs of colour.
options.viewport: Login: the 3D dish on a brass tray in a top-down sufra of small plates, green ground, form on a white panel. Dashboard: za'atar-green rail, herb-white ground, the 'sufra map' leading: each menu category a plate whose fill shows items with photos and 3D models; tap a plate to open them.
options.risk: Food palette can turn into a theme if the sufra map is not a real, clickable data graphic.

raised.raise: Each nav section owns a spice hue (za'atar Menu, turmeric AI, sumac Restaurant, nigella Team) used as wayfinding.
The sufra map is the dashboard's one owning graphic, not one widget among many.
Destructive actions stand alone, separated by deliberate space, outline until focused.
Dish photos pack as whole-cell thumbnails: dense, the photo carries the row.
Hierarchy by scale contrast: big Arabic numerals and titles, small quiet labels, few weights.

options.label: Shopfront sign — يافطة المحل
options.lineage: hand-painted Arabic restaurant shopfront signs and backlit menu boards
options.thesis: Every page title painted like the restaurant's own sign; enamel colours on a clean working surface.
options.viewport: Login: the name painted as a shop sign above a lit menu-board panel where the 3D dish turns. Dashboard: white surface, cobalt rail, titles in a sign-painter Arabic display face.
options.risk: Familiar to every Arab street, and loud: the display type must stay on titles or it shouts over the work.

options.label: Boarding pass & gate board
options.lineage: airport departure boards and segmented boarding passes
options.thesis: Generation jobs as a live departures board: rows rerank in place, a changed status stays lit until seen.
options.viewport: Dashboard led by the AI queue as a board; items carry a segmented pass (photo, mesh, texture, AR-ready).
options.case: Holds product clarity (the 3D queue is a departures board) but owners don't identify with airports.
options.risk: Reads as a travel app outside the jobs screen.

options.label: Acetate tab manual
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals with coloured tab dividers
options.thesis: Sections as coloured divider boards under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the edge.
options.case: Restaurant owners don't live in manuals.
options.kept: Section hues as wayfinding (a spice per nav section).

options.label: Factory catalog sleeve
options.thesis: Coded colour strips instead of words, one plot on black.
options.case: Coded labels fight clarity for busy owners.
options.kept: One graphic owns the dashboard (the sufra map).

options.label: Dark developer console
options.case: Engineer's world, and too close to SuperAdmin's dark console.

options.label: Convention circle catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-size thumbnails in a numbered grid.
options.viewport: Dense thumbnail grid keyed to a map.

options.label: Variable font specimen
options.case: No link to restaurants or dishes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean restaurant SaaS admin, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: White sidebar, KPI cards, tables; login with a dish photo beside the form.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every restaurant SaaS by design.
